summary: Self-service portal disconnected values: the catalog provider orgs, the optional built-in PostgreSQL image, values-tarball.yaml for HTTP plug-in registry delivery, imageRegistry as host only (the chart appends ansible-automation-platform/automation-portal; use ociPluginImage for other paths), then helm install redhat-rhaap-portal with -f values-oci.yaml.
questions: Should imageRegistry include a repository path?
How do I install the self-service portal with tarball plug-ins?
What helm command installs the self-service automation portal?

answer_card.title: Install the portal chart offline
answer_card.answer_md:
Set `imageRegistry` to the registry host only, for example `mirror.example.com`. The chart adds `ansible-automation-platform/automation-portal` itself; if your mirror uses another path, set `ociPluginImage` to the full image path.

```bash
helm install redhat-rhaap-portal \
  redhat-rhaap-portal-x.y.z.tgz \
  --namespace "${MY_NAMESPACE}" \
  -f /path/to/values-oci.yaml
```
